checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds.
must.why: The assistant says the reel is about 11.7 s, and the clips are 2.3 s each. The final reel was not supplied. Vertical 480x858 is confirmed from the frames.

must.item: All five supplied café photos appear recognizably in the requested order.
must.why: Only the storefront and latte clips were provided, and both are recognizable in that order. The croissant, barista and interior clips could not be checked.

must.item: Each photo has enough screen time to be recognizable, rather than appearing only as a flash.
must.why: Each clip runs about 2.3 s and is recognizable in the frames shown.

must.item: Relaxed instrumental music is audible, with no speech or singing.
must.why: A 15 s wav with a -1 dB peak exists, and the clip audio is at -13.7 dB. The music content cannot be judged from the numbers.

must.item: Transitions between photos are smooth, and no added text appears.
must.why: The assistant admits the shots join with straight cuts, not smooth transitions. No text appears in the frames.

faults.what: Transitions are hard cuts, but the user asked for smooth transitions.
Total length is about 11.7 s instead of 10 s. The assistant admits this.
The storefront clip is re-generated. It adds a large empty road area and changes the framing and the building. The awning and the chairs are altered.
The latte clip is re-created, not animated from the photo. The background changes to chairs and a window, and the cup shape and the latte art drift. The photo is not faithfully preserved.
The final stitched reel and the croissant, barista and interior clips were not available to check.

summary: The agent made a vertical reel with slow camera moves and no text. It joins the shots with hard cuts, not the smooth transitions requested. It runs about 11.7 s, and the AI re-created the scenes so the photos drift noticeably from the originals.
